# Copilot guidance

Follow AGENTS.md and docs/versioning.md. This project is currently documentation and design only.
Keep approved product requirements separate from proposed architecture decisions.
Do not implement or publish until explicitly authorized.
Do not automatically bump major versions, including for breaking changes during 0.x development.
Use immutable definitions, stable field identities, exact historical references, server-authoritative validation, and host-controlled authorization.
Before depending on @coderlifenet UI packages, inspect real exports and peer compatibility.
Implementation reports must distinguish changed, tested, and human-reviewed work, with evidence.
